title: Tim Taylor's background as NASA mission controller
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Tim Taylor's background as NASA mission controller, about 1980s-present at Kennedy Space Center, Florida, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He's a mysterious rocket scientist who's done mission control for NASA since the8s.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a man named Tim Taylor as a mysterious rocket scientist who, he says, has worked in mission control for NASA, the US space agency, since the 1980s, at Kennedy Space Center in Florida, where NASA launches its rockets. Michels raises it in an episode about why, as its title puts it, NASA studies a man who attracts UFOs. If true, it would mean that someone with strange experiences sits in the heart of the space programme.
